name: Allele: Origin
source:
An ongoing plague has pushed humanity to the brink of extinction. Born from mankind's desperation to survive, monsters evolved. 

[From [url=https://coffeedripstudios.itch.io/allele-origin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一場仍在蔓延的瘟疫將人類逼到了滅絕的邊緣。正是在人類渴求生存的絕望中，怪物應運而生，演化成形。
